title: A smooth compactly supported function times a constant covector is a test form in Dⁿ(U) (test-form claims of Steps 6–7 of the parent proof)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set, let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f, i.e. smooth of every finite order) with compact support (HasCompactSupport f) and tsupport f ⊆ U, and let θ ∈ Covector (Eucl P) n be a fixed n-covector. Then there is a test form φ ∈ Dⁿ(U) (φ : TestFormOn U n) with φ(x) = f(x)·θ for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (θ : Covector (Eucl P) n), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → ∃ φ : TestFormOn U n, ∀ x, (φ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x = f x • θ
